The trace does not show a higher-priority real-time thread causing these preemptions: sampler was normal priority (nice 0), and the identified CPU time was mostly idle or interrupt handling. The listed thread holding the CPU most was ticker’s uploader (TID 630625), also normal priority (nice 0). The CPU-occupancy attribution is low confidence.
